author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Fall River police arrested a 21-year-old man Thursday after investigators said a search of a Pulaski Street home uncovered a short-barreled rifle, a suppressor and ammunition.
NBC 10 reported that the department’s Community Action and Suppression Team executed the warrant with assistance from the Emergency Services Unit. Police identified the target as Devin Alves.

Detectives said they recovered a Palmetto State Armory rifle fitted with a 30-round magazine containing 30 live .300 Blackout rounds. Investigators also reported finding a black-powder revolver, 9 mm ammunition and a magazine for a .22-caliber Taurus rifle.

Alves faces charges that include possession of a large-capacity firearm, possession of a firearm and ammunition without the required state credentials, possession of a silencer, possession of a large-capacity feeding device and improper firearm storage. The accusations remain allegations, and the report did not include a court disposition or a response from the defendant. The seizure adds a new case to Fall River’s ongoing enforcement work involving unlawfully held weapons.
dek: Police arrested a 21-year-old after a Pulaski Street search that investigators say recovered multiple weapons and ammunition.
headline: Fall River search finds short-barreled rifle and suppressor, police say
